clue.text: Reign nervously in an African country

clue.text: Under control? No, ratings out of control

clue.text: Saucy dance?

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a lively Latin dance and also a Mexican relish of chopped tomato and chilli.

clue.text: Don't move prop, fixed
